source: curated verified hardware index — small GRBL 2-axis machine (pen plotter / drag-knife / light diode laser). Prices are real 2026 ballparks; confirm at the link.

components.name: NEMA17 stepper motor (1.8°, ~0.4-0.5 Nm, e.g. 17HS4401)
components.what: The two axis motors that move the tool head. One per axis.

components.name: Arduino Uno R3 (or compatible clone)
components.what: The microcontroller board that runs GRBL firmware. A clone works fine.

components.name: CNC Shield V3 (GRBL-compatible)
components.what: Plugs onto the Arduino Uno; holds the stepper driver modules and breaks out endstop/spindle pins.

components.name: A4988 stepper driver module (or DRV8825)
components.what: One driver per stepper; sets microstepping and current. Buy a spare.

components.name: 12V/24V 5A DC power supply
components.what: Powers the motors and drivers. 12V is fine for a small plotter; 24V for a laser.

components.name: GT2 timing belt + 20T pulleys + idlers kit
components.what: Converts stepper rotation into linear motion of each axis.

components.name: 8mm smooth rod + LM8UU linear bearings set
components.what: The linear guides the carriages ride on. (MGN12 linear rails are a smoother, pricier upgrade.)

components.name: 2020 aluminium extrusion frame set (~1.5m + brackets)
components.what: The rigid structure. A laser-cut ply or 3D-printed frame is a cheaper alternative.

components.name: SG90 / MG90S micro servo (pen lift)
components.what: Raises and lowers the pen between strokes. Cheapest tool head to start with.

components.name: Mechanical endstop / limit switch (pack)
components.what: Homing switches so the machine knows where each axis starts.

components.name: USB A-to-B cable + M3 fastener/coupling kit
components.what: USB links the Uno to your computer; the fastener kit and 5mm shaft couplings hold everything together.

components.name: Diode laser module 10W (optional tool head, PWM/TTL)
components.what: Optional upgrade to engrave/cut. DANGEROUS — see the safety section. Skip for a first build.
